references.text: The priest makes atonement for sin through the sin offering, the same principle as in the cleansing ritual
The sin offering is brought forward to make atonement for impurity and sin
Sin offering and burnt offering are required together for cleansing after impurity
The same order with sin offering before burnt offering in the cleansing ritual for lepers
The priest makes atonement with sin offering and burnt offering to cleanse from impurity
Atonement for impurity through the priest's service
The atonement cleanses from all sins and impurities
Christ's blood cleanses from impurity far more effectively than animal sacrifices under the old covenant
The Old Testament sacrifices were shadows pointing forward to Christ's perfect sacrifice
